# hf-to-litertlm

> Convert open-weight Hugging Face LLMs and VLMs into `.litertlm` bundles for Google's LiteRT-LM runtime (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux). 84 published conversions on Hugging Face (78 in litert-community, 6 under mlboydaisuke), each with measured speeds and a one-command reproduction. Independent converter, not affiliated with Google.

```bash
uv sync                                                    # the pinned toolchain (uv.lock) into .venv
uv run python scripts/convert.py <org>/<model>             # -> out/<model>/<model>_int8.litertlm + <model>.lock.json
uv run python scripts/verify_lock.py out/<model>/<model>.lock.json   # rebuild from the lock: MATCH = the same bytes
uv run litert-lm run out/<model>/*.litertlm --prompt "Hello"         # same bundle runs on a phone
```

The same scripts run from PyPI without a clone: `uvx hf-to-litertlm <org>/<model>` converts on the `uv.lock` of the commit the package was built from and writes under `./out`; `uvx hf-to-litertlm verify <lock>` and `uvx hf-to-litertlm check <bundle>` run `scripts/verify_lock.py` and `scripts/check_bundle.py`. The hybrid families and `--curated` need a clone.

`convert.py` exits 0 = converted and gated, 1 = converted but the 8-question gate or the one-prompt check (`scripts/check_bundle.py`) failed, 2 = refused (gated, remote-code, pre-quantized repos: a JSON reason) or stopped before any download (repo or revision not found), 3 = any later failure. Every failure ends in one `FAIL <stage>: … -> next: …` line on stderr.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/README.md): the model table (device, backend and tok/s per row), the finetune converter, setup, reproduction, new architectures, int4 recipes, deployment manifests.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/AGENTS.md): for coding agents. Task → command → file, and the rules: the exit gate decides, a refusal is an answer, numbers carry a device and a date, the tokenizer is the repo's own, a re-pack that changes the model type or template changes behaviour.
- [skills/android-device-gate/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/skills/android-device-gate/SKILL.md): an agent skill. Check a converted LiteRT graph on a shared Android phone with tools/devicebench, from a fake-phone dry run on the Mac to the record of every leg.
- [REPRODUCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/REPRODUCE.md): the full measurement record behind every published bundle, one command per model.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): request a model by pasting its Hugging Face link; report a misbehaving bundle.

## Converter

- [scripts/convert.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/scripts/convert.py): entry gate → adapter merge → export → post-export guards → exit gate. Routes by `config.json` `model_type`.
- [scripts/verify_quality.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/scripts/verify_quality.py): the exit gate, 8 fixed questions, bar 6/8.
- [scripts/export_simple_template.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/scripts/export_simple_template.py): the LLM engine (chat template + quant recipe + env knobs); defines the int4 recipes BOCTAV4, BOCTAV4_128 and BMIX4.
- [scripts/reproduce_llm.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/scripts/reproduce_llm.sh), [scripts/reproduce_vlm.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/scripts/reproduce_vlm.sh): rebuild a published bundle with one command (`--list` for keys).
- [scripts/ship_qwen2vl_derivative.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/scripts/ship_qwen2vl_derivative.sh): the VLM derivative pipeline, ending in the tokenizer-parity gate ([scripts/gate_specials.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/scripts/gate_specials.py)).
- [qwen35_work/convert_qwen38_27b.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/qwen35_work/convert_qwen38_27b.sh): Qwen3.8-27B end to end on a 128 GiB Mac: an F32 copy of the checkpoint read through mmap, a read-only ±inf check in place of litert-torch's in-place clamp, the int4 build written into its output file, then the thinking-off re-pack.
- [tools/tokenizer_parity/](https://github.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/tree/main/tools/tokenizer_parity): compare a bundle's tokenizer with the repo's own tokenizer.json and swap the section when they differ (AutoTokenizer.save_pretrained can rewrite the pre-tokenizer).
- [tools/gpu_graph/](https://github.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/tree/main/tools/gpu_graph): rewrite a bundle's KV writes and attention products into the GPU composites without re-exporting; every weight byte unchanged
- [tools/tfl_compare/](https://github.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/tree/main/tools/tfl_compare): compare two .litertlm graph sections by structure (operators, options, constants) when their bytes differ
- [tools/vlm_text_ckpt/](https://github.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/tree/main/tools/vlm_text_ckpt): export a VLM's text tower through the LLM rail as a derived CausalLM checkpoint (prefix rename, untied head, text_config as config.json), with the fp32 logits proof of the remap against the full model.
- [docs/vision-tower-reauthor.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/docs/vision-tower-reauthor.md): re-authoring a vision tower in plain PyTorch for the fast_vlm contract (constant positions, block-diagonal window mask, strided-slice merges, fp16-safe LayerNorm, the gates and the quantization form), from MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B.
- [docs/deepstack-wide-embedding.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/docs/deepstack-wide-embedding.md): Qwen3-VL's DeepStack through the fast_vlm path exactly (an 8,196-wide image embedding with an image flag, the decoder adding each part after layers 0–2, M-RoPE computed in the graph from the 1-D position and the flag), what adding DeepStack into one embedding cost, the text-only limit, and the runtime's second-message stop-token defect on every file with an embedder section, from WeVisOne-VL-2B.
- [docs/fp16-safe-norms.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/docs/fp16-safe-norms.md): fp16-safe RMSNorm for raw graphs: a per-site power-of-two rescale that keeps fp32 bit-exact, the rsqrt clamp for padding rows, a finite mask constant, float output masks.

## Running the bundles

- [docs/android-gpu.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/docs/android-gpu.md), [docs/android-npu.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/docs/android-npu.md): GPU and NPU on Android for these bundles, measured, and a one-graph-at-a-time engine for a pipeline larger than the phone's memory (text-to-image).
- [tools/devicebench/](https://github.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/tree/main/tools/devicebench): one harness for on-device gates of LiteRT graphs on Android: an owned hold on a shared phone, legs from a plan file, a 2-second clock, thermal and memory sampler, host scoring of every finished leg, and a fake-phone dry run on the Mac.
- [tools/chat_template_prefix/](https://github.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/tree/main/tools/chat_template_prefix): check a `.litertlm` chat template against LiteRT-LM's multi-turn rule (each message's render must extend the previous one, also in the refill after a reply that carried a thought): a desk renderer calibrated against the runtime's own error strings, a three-turn table, and the metadata-only fix.
- [tools/chat_template_parts/](https://github.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/tree/main/tools/chat_template_parts): dual-form (string and content parts) versions of the published bundles' chat templates with the metadata-only swap, and `two_turn_increment.py`, the desk check that the cache after a second message equals the upstream prompt (the newline after the stop token).
- [tools/externalize/](https://github.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/tree/main/tools/externalize): re-pack one published `.litertlm` so the weights of its TFLiteModel sections sit in TFLiteWeights sections at the end of the file, with LiteRT's public externalize tools at a pinned commit: section-by-section and tensor-by-tensor checks, a dtype breakdown (what the WebGPU streamed path takes), a CPU smoke, a staged report.
- [hfmodels-android](https://github.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android): one Gradle line and a few lines of Kotlin to a first reply; the walkthrough pins LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct on a Pixel 8a.
- [swift-litert-lm](https://github.com/john-rocky/swift-litert-lm): `LiteRTChat(huggingFaceRepo:fileName:)` on iPhone and Mac; [recipe for a fine-tuned model on iPhone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/swift-litert-lm/main/docs/recipe-hf-finetune-to-iphone.md).

## Deployment manifests

- [manifest/SCHEMA.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/manifest/SCHEMA.md): `litertlm_manifest.json`, which file fits which device, backend and RAM budget at what measured speed; registered in SchemaStore.
- [manifest/make_manifest.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/manifest/make_manifest.py) and [manifest/examples/](https://github.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/tree/main/manifest/examples): the generator and finished manifests.
- [readers/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/main/readers/README.md): reference readers (TypeScript, Dart) and the SDK entry points with their verification scope.
- [tools/play_ai_pack/](https://github.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/tree/main/tools/play_ai_pack): the manifest as a Google Play for On-device AI pack.

## Model cards and bundles

- [cards/](https://github.com/john-rocky/hf-to-litertlm/tree/main/cards): one card per converted bundle.
- [litert-community on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/litert-community): the published bundles; each repo ships `litertlm_manifest.json`.
